title: Zesty Velvety Greek Eggs Saganaki
description: A hearty and flavorful Greek dish featuring free-range eggs, dashi extract, and a velvety texture, perfect for a post-workout meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the beaten eggs, dashi extract, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped sun-dried tomatoes, artichoke hearts, and kalamata olives to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour the egg mixture over the ingredients in the skillet and cook for 2 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the crumbly feta cheese over the top.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the chopped fresh parsley over the top.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the dish and serve hot.
